description: Every insurer (payer) in the snapshot, independent of any code, most hospitals first, with display_name, hospital_count, code_count and payer_rate_rows. About 70, so unpaginated. Use the payer_slug with get_payer, list_payer_plans, list_payer_hospitals and the code-level payer tools. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

min_hospital_count.description: Leave out payers filed by fewer hospitals than this, to drop the long tail. 0 (default) returns all.

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS state code (e.g. "TX", case-insensitive): only hospitals with a location in that state are counted. A hospital in several states counts in each, so state figures can add up to more than national ones. Empty means every hospital; anything that is not a state code is rejected as INVALID_ARGUMENT.
